Subject: Launch Position Update and Next Steps

Hi Avery,

Our launch was tentatively scheduled for October 8, 2026. However, our security review—which is owned by Nia—now completes on October 12 at the earliest. Because the release requires completed approval, and the review may still require remediation, no new production date is authorized at this time. 

Our team remains completely focused on delivering a secure, high-quality release, and we are prepared to keep momentum going. To that end, we can still conduct a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. 

Please let me know if you accept proceeding with the staging demo on October 8 so we can prepare accordingly.

Best regards,

Jordan  
Engagement Lead
